scenes.title: Two tides
scenes.purpose: Plant the surprising claim and the visual identity (teal field, heavy type, amber marker) before any explanation.
scenes.viewerShouldNotice: The word TWO in amber, and a wave with exactly two crests, by 1.5s.
scenes.focalPoint: TWO TIDES headline, left third, upper area
scenes.motionWhy: Words arrive one after another like successive tides.

transitionOut.motivation: A rising waterline carries us into the explanation.

scenes.title: Two bulges
scenes.purpose: Explain the cause: show the Moon pulling a near bulge and a far-side bulge, which a headline alone could not justify.
scenes.viewerShouldNotice: Two bulges on opposite sides of Earth, labelled, by 3s.
scenes.focalPoint: Earth with ocean ellipse, right of centre
scenes.motionWhy: The growth of the ellipse is the claim: water piles up on both sides.

transitionOut.motivation: Same waterline wipe; the amber ground of the next scene signals the answer.

scenes.title: 12.4 hours
scenes.purpose: Convert the picture into a number the viewer can keep: the interval between high tides.
scenes.viewerShouldNotice: The counter landing on 12.4 h at about 1.9s.
scenes.motionWhy: The counting effort lets the eye settle on the final figure.

transitionOut.motivation: Return to teal for the closing line.

scenes.title: Moon sets the clock
scenes.purpose: Compress the film into one line the viewer can repeat.
scenes.viewerShouldNotice: MOON in amber as the first word to land.
scenes.motionWhy: A calm reveal and a hold lets the sentence land and ends the film.
